core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghayoor corresponds to the Arabic form غيور (Arabic root غ ي ر (gh-y-r); غيور (Ghayūr)). Its core sense is zealous for honour, protective jealousy. Ghayoor is Arabic غيور (Ghayūr) 'zealous for honour, protective of what is sacred, jealous in the honourable sense', an intensive adjective from the root غ ي ر (gh-y-r). The source gloss 'light, radiant' belongs to a different root (ن و ر) and has been replaced.
